item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "57487b30103484461251005a54e37a1b1ec9290776b3b6fd1c5102a6210a9617",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef004 q flux: interval integrability of each spatial slice and the interval balance derivative identity, for every pair of real endpoints and every real time.",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces the global integral balance hypothesis, including its integrability conjunct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef003 q flux x t: existence of the time derivative and spatial flux derivative at (x,t), with their sum equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expands the conclusion into an existential pointwise differential balance statement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For a finite coordinate type, there exist vectors u and v such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative u at t, ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) has derivative v at x, and u + v = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "At each real x, the conclusion requires both derivative assertions and their zero-sum identity. The existential vectors can depend on x and the previously fixed data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For every a,b,s ∈ ℝ, the function x ↦ q(x,s) is interval integrable from a to b, and τ ↦ ∫_a^b q(x,τ) dx has derivative flux(q(a,s)) − flux(q(b,s)) at s.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the integral balance at all real times, not merely at the selected time t, with left-endpoint flux minus right-endpoint flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on ι → ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity needed to express vector-valued derivatives in the local differential predicate; adds no hypothesis on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on ι → ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity needed for vector-valued derivatives in the integral balance predicate; adds no regularity hypothesis on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary addition and zero while supplying the weaker structure used in scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The real scalar action on real coordinates is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the scalar action of the real self-algebra in the continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Continuous",
      "meaning": "Continuity of a function between its specified topological spaces.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires x ↦ qt(x) + fluxx(x) to be continuous on all of ℝ with values in the finite product topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Obtains a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field while retaining its normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivial real norm required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a multiplicative action from an action that also distributes over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the ordinary scalar action while supplying its underlying action structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring used for the real vector-space module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's commutative semiring operations and multiplicative inverses as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Changes only the available structural interface, not real arithmetic or the quantified domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vectors have exactly m real coordinates; m = 0 is allowed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Provides a complete finite enumeration of Fin n using its range of indices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Establishes finiteness for the vector norms, normed-space instances, and local predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a heterogeneous-addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here denotes ordinary coordinatewise vector addition in the residual and its zero-sum identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the full neighborhood of that point with the base point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "All derivatives are ordinary two-sided real derivatives with vector values, not one-sided, within-set, weak, or distributional derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector-space structure from an inner-product-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ordinary real normed-space structure on each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "A function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The spatial slices, qt, and fluxx must be integrable between every pair of finite real endpoints, with either endpoint order allowed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology ensures jointly continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the scalar action on real coordinates without an additional target assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring also satisfies the topological semiring requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries continuity of real ring operations into the construction of continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "The topology of a topological semiring is a module topology for its action on itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the standard continuous real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure from a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability and integral expressions use the same distinguished measure of Real.measureSpace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real scalar multiplication underlying the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication from a monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar semigroup structure without modifying multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid structure from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real scalar-action instances and does not exclude the zero scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action used in the vector-valued calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The universally quantified dimension m is finite and nonnegative, with no positivity assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a nonunital commutative ring's operations while forgetting the associativity requirement in the resulting interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides weaker real ring structure for topological instances without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital, nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure needed for the topological-ring conversion on ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts commutative addition and zero from the semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real additive structure for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the algebraic nonunital commutative ring structure of a normed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real ring operations to the continuity machinery without an additional restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and operations used to construct the coordinate normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive normed structure on real coordinates for derivatives and integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the weaker nonunital, nonassociative semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in obtaining real commutative addition for the vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed-field structure of a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual real norm and field operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and metric while dropping commutativity from the required interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports construction of the finite-product norm used in interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with the corresponding extended nonnegative norm and additive-monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability uses the ordinary vector norm viewed as an extended nonnegative quantity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while omitting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an underlying real ring structure for topological-ring instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual real analytic structure through weaker interfaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real arithmetic for scalar and module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative ring operations, and metric of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same real norm and topology throughout the calculus expressions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the linear structure used by HasDerivAt, with ordinary real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Makes functions I → β a module using coordinatewise module operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative codomain Fin m → ℝ is the real vector space with coordinatewise linear operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Forms the additive commutative group of dependent functions using coordinatewise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, subtraction, and zero have their usual coordinatewise meanings.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The residual is the vector whose ith coordinate is qt(x)(i) + fluxx(x)(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Provides the standard finite-product normed additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The interval integrals take values in a finite-dimensional real normed vector space with its finite-product norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Provides the standard normed additive group structure on a finite product of normed additive groups.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the vector norm underlying the integrability hypotheses for qt and fluxx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "A finite product of normed spaces is a normed space with coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → ℝ an eligible codomain for the real vector-valued integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology generated by the coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Continuity and convergence of the finite vectors are equivalent to coordinatewise continuity and convergence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the usual absolute-value metric on ℝ into its topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips an RCLike field with its real inner-product-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "At the real instance, supplies the ordinary one-dimensional real normed-space structure; no complex coordinates are introduced.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Space, time, scalar values, and all vector coordinates are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The densely normed-field structure on ℝ extending Real.normedField.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the ordinary real scalar field meets the requirements for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinatewise residual uses ordinary real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive structure inherited by the vector codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra and does not restrict coordinates to nonnegative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real instance of RCLike, with real-part map the identity, imaginary-part map zero, and its designated I equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real normed and inner-product structures; the target remains entirely real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides standard real addition and multiplication for the module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The canonical measure-space instance on ℝ, whose volume is the usual Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Spatial integrability and interval integrals are with respect to real Lebesgue measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the coordinate norms and metric used in vector integrability and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the algebraic and analytic structures on real coordinates compatible.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual absolute-value norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets the scalar norm and field operations for derivatives and integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real metric structure with distance d(x,y) = |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "All real continuity and neighborhood limits use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure of ordinary real arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-algebra and module-topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in the module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semifield's semiring operations and inverses as a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker interface to the same real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the existing real scalar multiplication in continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm and commutative ring operations while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive seminormed structure on ℝ without changing its norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real pseudometric used for topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the topology compatible with the real norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication, one, and zero with their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar multiplicative structure without adding assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in obtaining real additive structure for modules; operations remain unchanged.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the topology induced by the usual real metric for continuity and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise scalar multiplication on a product is jointly continuous when each coordinate scalar action is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous real scalar multiplication on the vector codomain with its product topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary addition operation as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition notation to the coordinatewise vector sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real numbers form a topological ring under their usual operations and topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity of real operations, not continuity of q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The oriented vector-valued integral ∫_a^b f dμ is the integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a].",
      "effect_on_target": "Reversing endpoints negates the integral, and equal endpoints give zero. The integral balance and interchange assumptions use this orientation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both constituent propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "The integral law requires both integrability and its derivative identity; the pointwise conclusion requires both derivative assertions and the zero-sum equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative-vector sum equals the zero vector exactly, equivalently in every coordinate; this is not almost-everywhere equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existence of a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "After each x is selected, the conclusion supplies two derivative vectors. Neither is required to be a single vector shared by all x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A type equipped with a finite enumeration containing all its elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "The generic local predicates use finite coordinate types, instantiated here by Fin m; finiteness does not require nonemptiness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation from a heterogeneous-subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes coordinatewise subtraction in the flux difference and oriented integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the standard real coordinate normed-space structure in the local predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type using its specified numeral instance.",
